pairs.evidence: src/lib/sentry.ts:5 This context has no long-lived streaming hop: Sentry events go straight to the DSN, with no `tunnel` or proxy route. A search of the context's files for EventSource, text/event-stream, keep-alive, heartbeat, getReader and ReadableStream found nothing. The only hits in src/lib were in other contexts' tests and server helpers, and the real SSE hops live in src/app/api/*/stream/route.ts, which this context does not own.
